jobs.title: Sustainability Systems and Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Who are we, and what do we do?
At Corteva Agriscience, you will help us grow what’s next. No matter your role, you will be part of a team that is building the future of agriculture – leading breakthroughs in the innovation and application of science and technology that will better the lives of people all over the world and fuel the progress of humankind.

We are seeking a Sustainability Systems and Analytics Manager – Low-Code Data Engineer to oversee and enhance Corteva's sustainability technology solutions. This role will ensure the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of ESG reporting tools, data pipelines, dashboards, and analytics platforms, including Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Sustainability Manager (MSM), and Environmental Resilience Analytics (ERA). The successful candidate will play a key role in advancing sustainability reporting, data governance, compliance, and infrastructure optimization across the organization. This role will will be based at our Global Headquarters in Indianapolis, IN. with our Hybrid work shedule.

What You’ll Do:
- Own and resolve data and metric calculation issues across MSM and ERA.
- Maintain dashboards and reports for internal and external stakeholders.
- Manage system interfaces and integrations (upstream/downstream).
- Ensure compliance with sustainability regulations and standards.
- Support data analysis and insights generation.
- Coordinating with data leads and system owners.
- Maintain and update configurations in Microsoft Sustainability Manager (MSM) and Fabric.
- Apply updates and patches from Microsoft GIT to MSM and related Power Platform applications.
- Oversee license management and renewals.
- Manage data ingestion, transformation, and storage pipelines in Fabric.
- Implement and monitor security protocols and data governance controls in Power Platform and Fabric environments.
- Integrate systems and tools across the Microsoft sustainability tech stack.
- Optimize cloud resources and ensure system uptime and backups in Power Platform Admin Center and Fabric Admin Portal.
- Lead change management for new data flows and notification systems.
- Maintain internal knowledge base and training materials.
- Manage a backlog of feature enhancements and prioritize updates.
- Enhance methodologies, reporting templates, and dashboard visualizations.
- Re-run data jobs and upload remediated data during error handling.
- Perform manual data runs outside scheduled freeze dates as needed.

What Skills You Need:
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree(s) in Sustainability, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse, Fabric Compute).
- Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Azure SQL, Azure Blob Storage, and One-Lake Architecture(s).
- Familiarity with MSM, ArcGIS, and ESG data schemas.
- Strong understanding of data governance, compliance, and security protocols.
- Experience with cloud resource monitoring and optimization.
- undefined
- Ability to analyze ESG data and generate actionable insights.
- Experience in dashboard design and report automation.
- Knowledge of sustainability frameworks (CSRD, TCFD, CDP, ISSB) and the GHG Protocol.
- undefined
- Experience managing data-change in data collection and reporting processes.
- Ability to prioritize and manage a backlog of enhancements.
- Strong documentation and knowledge base management skills.
- undefined
- Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement.
- Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
- Collaborative mindset with cross-functional teams (IT, ESG, Data Owners).

Skills that are nice to have:
- 5+ years of experience in ESG reporting or sustainability technology management.
- 3+ Years experience in Managing Fabric One-Lake, Synapse Analytics, Databricks workspaces for a global enterprise.
- Certifications in Microsoft Power Platform or Azure are a plus.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Intern
jobs.description:
At Corteva Agriscience , you will help us grow what’s next. No matter what your role, you will be part of a team that is building the future of agriculture – solving the world’s food problems through innovation, technology, and putting people first. We have an exciting opportunity for a Business Intelligence Intern at our Indianapolis, IN location.

We are seeking a motivated graduate or undergraduate candidate eager to gain global, hands-on experience in the agricultural crop protection industry. You’ll support strategic initiatives by analyzing competitor crop protection strategies, financials, routes to market, and innovation pipelines.  You will help shape data-drive decisions that impact on our business and farmers.

What You’ll Do :
- - Research and monitor key competitors in the farm input space (e.g., herbicides, fungicides, insecticides, biologicals).
- Track product launches, regulatory changes, patent activity, and M&A developments.
- Analyze market trends including adoption of biologicals, resistance management, and digital ag tools.
- Support the development of competitor profiles, SWOT analyses, and market share assessments.
- Assist in preparing executive briefings, dashboards, and presentations.
- Collaborate with marketing, R&D, regulatory, and commercial teams to validate findings and gather insights.

What Skills You Need:
- - Pursuing a Bachelor’s or MBA/master’s degree in Agribusiness, Agricultural Economics, Business, or a related field.
- Strong finance, market research and analytical skills; familiarity with agricultural markets is a plus.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, and online research tools.
- Excellent communication and organizational skills.

What You’ll Gain:
- - Exposure to strategic decision-making in a global agriculture company.
- Experience with real-world market intelligence tools and frameworks.
- Mentorship from industry professionals in crop protection.
- A deeper understanding of the challenges and innovations shaping modern agriculture.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Responsible for leading and developing the regional sales organization, driving business growth in the retail and farm segments, and managing a team of Retail and Farm Sales Representatives. Ensures effective execution of commercial strategies, customer engagement, and field activities to achieve sales, market share, and profitability objectives within the assigned region.
Key Responsibilities
- Lead, coach, and develop Retail and Farm Sales Representatives to maximize performance and customer satisfaction.
- Execute regional sales plans and deliver revenue, volume, and market share targets.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with key retailers, growers, and influential stakeholders.
- Identify business opportunities and implement initiatives to expand market penetration and customer loyalty.
- Ensure effective deployment of sales, marketing, and agronomic programs at the regional level.
- Monitor sales performance, customer trends, and competitive activities, taking corrective actions when necessary.
- Collaborate with distributors, marketing, technical, and supply chain teams to support business objectives.
- Manage regional forecasting, budgeting, and territory planning activities.
- Ensure compliance with company policies, commercial processes, and regulatory requirements.

Key Success Measures
- Achievement of regional sales and profitability targets
- Growth in market share and customer penetration
- Performance and development of Retail and Farm Sales Representatives
- Customer satisfaction and retention
- Quality of forecast accuracy and business planning
- Effective execution of commercial and marketing initiatives

Requirements:
- University degree – degree in agriculture will be an advantage.
- At least 5 years of experience in commercial roles in the agriculture sector.
- Team Leadership experience
- Business proficiency in English both written and verbal. Native Polish
- Open minded, ready to catch good opportunities spotted in any platform and adaptable to changing market condition.
- Hard working individual with focus on results.
- Excellent communication, able to establish relationships and build strong network within the industry and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
- Proven ability to influence and engage stakeholders, with strong persuasive skills to effectively sell ideas and strategies.
- High amount of travel around the country visiting different stakeholders.

jobs.title: Territory Sales Manager - Urban Pest Management
jobs.description:
This position is responsible for managing existing and new customer relationships. The Territory Sales Manager sells Corteva products and solutions while identifying new opportunities for unmet customer needs - driving profitable business growth.

Core Responsibilities:
Corteva Agriscience has an exciting opportunity for a Sales Representative in the Urban Pest Management Business. This is a virtual office position located in Nashville, TN area but can be flexible to the surrounding areas within the territory. The Urban Pest Management Sales Representative will be responsible for overall management and achievement of sales plan in the Tennessee and southwestern Kentucky territory. The Urban Pest Management Sales Representative will be responsible for overall management and achievement of sales plan. You will be a member of a highly effective sales team which utilizes innovative marketing tools and strategies to help Pest Management customers sell their services, featuring Corteva’s products.

Primary Responsibilities:
- Develop and execute strategies and tactics designed to increase Corteva sales with existing direct buying customers referred to as “Certified Sentricon Specialists”, CSS’s in the TN and KY territory.
- Serve as a “business consultant” to existing accounts, bringing value to their business via our business model and product performance.
- Actively manage marketing and sales programs, accounts receivable, inventory management, revenue validation, technical training and overall coordination and maintenance of account activities.
- Be a liaison between our customers and our internal teams to ensure timely and successful delivery of our solutions according to customer needs and experiences.
- Experience with cold calling, aggressively prospecting new customers in B2B sales
- Develop and monitor territory budgets – including promotional, travel & entertainment and general territory expense budgets.
- Maintain company equipment, vehicles and records in a proper and safe manner.
- A safe driving record is required. A valid driver’s license and the ability to operate a motor vehicle is mandatory at all times for this position.
- Represent Corteva with the Pest Management Professionals and Associations within each state and earn leadership positions within the industry.
- Conduct all activities with a high level of professionalism and represent Corteva each day in a manner that is respectful, safe and would reflect positively on our company.

Critical Success Factors:
- Ability to develop Objectives, Strategies and Tactics for the territory and demonstrate high flexibility and agility as the needs and challenges of the territory evolve over time.
- Strong initiative, assertiveness and results orientation will be necessary. ‘Hunter’ mentality to seek out opportunities and develop new markets.
- Previous experience demonstrating that you are a self-starter who is highly productive and have the ability to work with diverse and cross-functional teams as well as work independently.
- Ability to lead and influence others.
- Good time management and decision-making skills.
- Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work with the many social styles of Sales Reps, customers and Industry Influencers who have differing needs.
- Effectively work with multiple levels of an organization from the Owner, CEO, CFO, Regional Management, Sales Staff, Technicians and Administrative personnel is critical.
- Excellent presentation development & presentation skills are required. Incumbent must be able to communicate the features, functions and benefits of Corteva products one-on-one and in large customer meeting settings in addition to having the ability to demonstrate through hands-on, in-field use and service of the Sentricon™ system
- Ability to work from a virtual location and master the use of technology and the communication tools to do so.
- Proficient computer skills with the ability to use Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and CRM systems such as SalesForce.

Job Information and Working Conditions:
- Direct report to the UPM District Sales Leader
- This is a virtual office role. Incumbents will be expected to live in the Nashville, TN area.
- 5-10 years of sales experience preferred
-Experience in Pest Control industry is a plus
- 60-70% travel time will be required with some weekend work expected.
- This role participates in the Sales Incentive Program (SIP).
- Corteva will provide a company vehicle

Preferred Qualifications:
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Creative thinker, innovator.
- Demonstrates technical aptitude of product knowledge
- Business and entrepreneurial skills and interests.
- Demonstrated leadership and teamwork.
- Customer-focused.
- Proficiency in computer technology.
- Comfortable with risk; accepts individual responsibility and accountability.

Education:
Bachelor's Degree in disciplines such as Marketing, Business Administration, Agriculture Economics, Engineering, Science, Entomology

We are seeking a North America Business Finance Analyst. This role will be based at out Global Headquarters in Indianapolis, IN.
